description.zh: 是否级联删除安全组规则。
description.en:
Specifies whether to cascade delete security group rules is enabled. Valid values:
- true: Cascade delete security group rules.
- false: Do not cascade delete security group rules.
The ID of the cloud-native API gateway.
The ID of the cloud-native API gateway security rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig delete-gateway-security-group-rule --gateway-id gw-cpv4sqdl00000 --security-group-rule-id gsgr-cpqnj1llht000 --cascading-delete true --region cn-hangzhou
